evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator compared the database-size information reported by the owner account against the expected 15.6 MB and found that the observed toot content was instead “Hello from Owner 👋”.

chains.rationale: The evaluator directly tests the frozen predicate by reporting that the expected 15.6 MB database-size result was not present in the owner account's observed toot content. The frozen continuous trace shows the reused Back premise initiating an unrecovered Account settings/Development/Your applications loop at step 17 and the same loop persisting through steps 48–50, with no database-size value or qualifying MB toot. The only frozen competing defect, wrong_overflow_menu_action, was corrected at the next step and does not independently suffice to explain the terminal failure; the full reconstruction reveals no other sufficient defect. Because a frozen competing defect exists at all, the stronger linkage level is unavailable even though it was corrected and insufficient.

summary: The unrecovered navigation loop plausibly contributed to the directly aligned failure to query and toot the owner database size in MB. Full reconstruction supports no independently sufficient alternative, but the presence of a corrected frozen competing defect precludes strong linkage.
